_about: Mood boards. The host chooses every image. To add one, put the file in src/assets/moodboards/<board id>/ and list it under that board with its file name, alt text and optional caption. Until images are supplied, each board shows the placeholder plates listed in "placeholders" (shape only).

boards.title: The Velvet Cellar
boards.subtitle: The overall aesthetic
boards.note: Underground speakeasies, champagne towers, candlelight, burgundy velvet, jazz clubs, card tables and Art Deco interiors.

images.alt: Black and white photograph from the 1920s: a party in evening dress around a grand fireplace, with two women sitting up on the mantelpiece raising their glasses.
A jazz trio with saxophone, double bass and drums playing in a small club draped in red velvet, lit by glowing table lamps.
A woman in a gold fringed flapper dress, beaded headband and long gloves pouring fizz into a tower of coupe glasses.
Men in white shirts and braces laughing around a card table covered in chips, cards and banknotes, while a woman fans out a handful of notes.
Black and white photograph: revellers with bottles and a cigar holding a sign that reads “In compliance with the 18th Amendment no intoxicating liquor allowed on the premises”.
Men in dinner jackets lounging in a smoky, candlelit room beside a blazing fire, with a woman in a gold dress stretched out on the rug among glasses and bottles.
A dark wooden dinner table seen from above, laid with black plates, newspaper menus, tall candles in wine bottles, strings of pearls and white feathers.
A party backdrop: a red foil curtain hung with newspaper bunting painted with the words “Have a killer b’day”, beside a table set with candles.
A woman in a gold sequinned flapper dress, pearls and feathered headband lifted into the air by a cheering group of men in waistcoats and bow ties.
Black and white photograph of three women in flapper dresses and beaded headbands laughing beside three men in dark suits and flat caps, in a panelled drawing room.

boards.title: The Ladies of The Velvet Cellar
boards.subtitle: Costume inspiration
boards.note: Glamorous eveningwear, flapper dresses, satin and velvet, beading, pearls, long gloves, feathers, sharp tailoring and a little femme fatale.

boards.title: The Gentlemen of The Velvet Cellar
boards.subtitle: Costume inspiration
boards.note: Three-piece suits, black tie, pinstripes, waistcoats, suspenders and bow ties, fedoras and flat caps, pocket watches, gamblers and gangsters.
